recipe.title: Chef John's Summer Scrambled Eggs
recipe.description: Chef John's recipe for scrambled eggs with cherry tomatoes, feta cheese, and fresh basil is a delicious breakfast option for any time of the year.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon very thinly sliced fresh basil leaves
steps: Whisk eggs and pepper flakes together in a bowl. Stir in tomatoes, feta, and basil.
Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over high heat until starting to shimmer. Pour egg mixture into hot oil and cook, without stirring, for 5 seconds.
Cook and stir egg mixture until eggs are scrambled and softly set, about 30 seconds. Transfer to a plate and sprinkle with sea salt.

tweaks.author: Eric Wright
tweaks.text: I tried this recipe and it was great. I fixed the tomato water problem. I had a hand colander and gently slide it into the colander. Once the water dripped through slide it back on the skillet. Reduced the water issue by a great deal.

tweaks.author: GaGa57
tweaks.text: I loved this recipe! I sautéed some chopped canadian bacon and onion along with the halved tomatoes before I added the eggs. The flavor was great, and it solved the problem of the water from the tomatoes. I had some crumbly English cheddar in my frig, and that worked fine. With cherry tomatoes and basil in my garden, I'll be making this a lot this summer!

tweaks.author: koolaide
tweaks.text: I haven't tried this exact recipe yet, but learned to make something similar from my Greek sister-in-law, a fabulous cook!! She actually cooked the cut tomatoes a bit first, to get most of the liquid out, and it seemed to actually intensify the flavor of the tomatoes. She also used Greek oregano. I like to add Cavender's Greek seasoning when I make them. Very simple and tasty!

tweaks.author: Cherlyn Lee
tweaks.text: I did not have cherry tomatoes, red pepper flakes, and feta cheese on hand, thus i used normal tomatoes, black pepper and mozzarella cheese respectively. I didn't want to use oil, so i substituted it with a little salted butter, thus I forgo the salt since the dish is already salty. I unfortunately did not have basil leaves on hand tho. Overall, it was still really good and tender! Really loved the dish so much that i made it a second time the next day for my family. I solved the water problem by cutting away the juicy, liquid part inside the normal tomatoes, which left little to no water in the dish.

tweaks.author: Roberta
tweaks.text: Follow chef John's instructions - do not overcook or feta melts & dish is dry. I like feta a bit on the chunky side so it doesn't over cook. Great way to use the bounty of summer cherry tomatoes & basil. Find one recipe is enough for two people when served with toast. When needing more than one recipe, have the ingredients all mixed & ready to go so there is little delay in cooking up the additional serving(s).
